name: SISO Foundry
summary: A source-mining and reuse-knowledge platform for discovering, evaluating, preserving, and navigating valuable external and SISO source.

reading.subtitle: Find what is worth reusing. Prove it before building on it.
reading.why: Good software already contains years of hard-won domain knowledge. Foundry makes that work discoverable and tests how it could serve a real business need, so each project does not have to start its research again. The Library preserves the resulting identities and receipts; Knowledge owns durable retrieval, and the product owner still decides what to adopt.

highlights.title: 9,636-repository evidence universe
highlights.summary: The v0.4.0 receipt anchors twenty scored applications and twelve evidence-qualified God Sources. These are dated findings, not a live inventory or automatic reuse permission.

highlights.title: Choose the adoption route
highlights.summary: The value matrix compares whole applications, APIs, sidecars, extraction, reference, and building. Each route carries proof gates, not just a popularity score.

highlights.title: Resumable discovery campaigns
highlights.summary: Versioned query contracts, checkpoints and source lineage make discovery repeatable. Candidate rights still require direct review before promotion.

reading.owner: SISO Open Source Foundation · Foundry owner

evidence.summary: Canonical public source includes the resumable source-campaign platform and the scored Agency OS value matrix while preserving the external data-plane boundary; the 30-file code check, three campaign tests, matrix arithmetic and evidence gates, intelligence invariants, and publication scan passed.

license.reason: The public repository contains reviewed SISO-owned software under MIT; dataset and upstream-source rights remain explicitly asset-specific and outside the source license claim.

evidence.summary: The public extraction records included software, excluded payloads, path normalization, and independent data/upstream ownership boundaries.

relationships.context: The Library registers identities, evidence and released reuse knowledge without copying Foundry's data plane.

evidence.summary: The application loop explicitly separates Foundry discovery from Library identity and release lineage.

relationships.context: Foundry discovers and evaluates sources; Knowledge governs durable corpus and retrieval semantics.

evidence.summary: The Knowledge model keeps source discovery and canonical knowledge governance independently addressable.

relationships.context: The Repo Bank is the published, read-only reuse-bank export from Foundry's identity database.

evidence.summary: The Repo Bank source record identifies the Foundry database as its export source.

Foundry 0.4.0 publishes the repository-by-use-case-by-route value matrix over the recovered 9,636-repository evidence universe, including twenty scored applications, twelve evidence-qualified God Sources, platform primitives, authority groups, agent-operation surfaces, and proof gates.

Foundry 0.3.0 adds the durable Agency intelligence mission, exact logical-source and query receipts, candidate and ownership boundaries, application map, and promotion backlog to the resumable source-campaign platform.
Foundry has an independent research outcome and belongs in the Research section rather than inside Agents.
Twenty-eight Python files compiled, JavaScript and shell entrypoints passed syntax checks, the topic-registry disposable-database smoke passed, and the publication scan passed.
